'''Vak Lako''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Trandoshan]] criminal who lived during the [[Republic Era]] and was a member of the [[Duros]] criminal [[Lazlo]]'s gang.<ref name="The Good Life" /> After Lazlo's death, Lako continued to serve Lazlo's successor, [[Cad Bane]]. Lako met with fellow gang member [[Tay Grutty]] at a spaceport, where they waited for Bane's [[shuttle]] while Grutty looked for Bane's girlfriend [[Arin]]. However, they found out she married [[Niro]], Bane’s former friend and the current marshal. When Bane arrived Lako gave his boss his hat. Lako used a [[blaster rifle]] to shoot from above but was shot down by [[Unidentified police droid model|police droids]].<ref name="One Good Deed" />
